request.style: English, male warm baritone solo, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, fiddle, soft drums, reflective and hopeful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Blessed are those whose way is blameless
Who walk in the law of the Lord
They keep his testimonies so
And seek him with their whole heart's core

[Chorus]
Blessed are those who walk in the law
Blessed are those who keep his word
Blessed are those who walk in the law
Blessed are those who keep his word

[Verse]
Indeed they do no wrong at all
They walk in his ways on the ground
You have laid down your precepts there
To be kept with care in every place

[Chorus]
Blessed are those who walk in the law
Blessed are those who keep his word
Blessed are those who walk in the law
Blessed are those who keep his word

[Bridge]
Oh that my ways were steady
In keeping your statutes true
My heart would find its rest then
In what your spirit has done

[Outro]
Blessed are those who walk in the law
Blessed are those who keep his word
